reviews.title: Now that's cooling.
reviews.comment: after ugrading to a faster CPU that runs pretty hot, this cooler just handles it like water.
reviews.author: RonaldR

reviews.title: Cool as a jewel
reviews.comment: Man oh man where do I start with this beauty. Now I run an I914900k which runs insanely hot and it used to be a bane on my existence when I bought it and my system would blue screen and crash now with this it keeps it insanely cool and with that keeps me from crashing. After a while if you have it set up where the heat dissipates upwards you’ll run into some odd sounds but it’s a simple enough fix you just need to move your pc around and you’ll be fine.
reviews.author: PatrickM

reviews.title: Wont get hot!
reviews.comment: This cooler keeps my cpu cool no matter what I do with my PC, you wont regret it!
reviews.author: Alberic

reviews.title: Great cooler just wish the RGB had better colors
reviews.comment: Keeps my 9800x3D nice and cool. While gaming the highest temps i see are the upper 60s. Love the magnetic fan system too. Just not a fan of the muted rgb colors. But thats just standard Corsair colors. You either love or hate them.
reviews.author: Ty81

reviews.title: Definitely recommend
reviews.comment: Great cooling system for your cpu. Have no regrets with it. And plus the rgb looks amazing. My temps are always low with this bad boy.
